Beyblade X Bit Tier List

Compare every Beyblade X bit using reported tournament top cuts. Open a bit to see the blades and complete combinations that use it most successfully.

The current #1 bit in this scope is Low Rush, with 35.7% of its 4,823 reported top cuts finishing 1st.

A letter tier requires at least 60 reported top cuts. “?” keeps the raw result visible without treating a small sample as a reliable ranking.
